{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
module CacheClient where

import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy as BL
import qualified Data.ByteString.Lazy.Char8 as BLC
import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.IORef
import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO)
import Text.XML.HXT.Core
import Text.XML.HXT.Parser.XmlParsec (xreadDoc)
import Data.Tree.NTree.TypeDefs
import Control.Arrow
import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe, listToMaybe)

-- Role-based access control types
data Role = Admin | ReadWrite | ReadOnly deriving (Show, Eq, Ord)
data Session = Session { sessionUser :: String, sessionRole :: Role, sessionToken :: String }

-- Cache entry with metadata
data CacheEntry = CacheEntry
  { entryValue :: String
  , entryOwner :: String
  , entryACL   :: Role
  } deriving (Show)

-- Global cache store
cacheStore :: IORef (Map.Map String CacheEntry)
cacheStore = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty
{-# NOINLINE cacheStore #-}

-- Session registry
sessionRegistry :: IORef (Map.Map String Session)
sessionRegistry = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty
{-# NOINLINE sessionRegistry #-}

-- Validate session and check minimum role
validateSession :: String -> Role -> IO (Maybe Session)
validateSession token minRole = do
  sessions <- readIORef sessionRegistry
  case Map.lookup token sessions of
    Nothing -> return Nothing
    Just s  -> if roleLevel (sessionRole s) >= roleLevel minRole
               then return (Just s)
               else return Nothing

roleLevel :: Role -> Int
roleLevel ReadOnly  = 1
roleLevel ReadWrite = 2
roleLevel Admin     = 3

-- XML configuration parser for cache policies
-- Uses a custom parser configuration that processes external references
-- for distributed cache node discovery
parseCacheConfig :: String -> IO [(String, String)]
parseCacheConfig xmlContent = do
  let doc = readString [withValidate no, withSubstDTDEntities yes] xmlContent
  pairs <- runX $ doc >>> getChildren >>> isElem >>> getChildren >>> isElem >>>
           (getName &&& (getChildren >>> getText))
  return pairs

-- Parse cache operation requests in XML format
-- This handles the distributed protocol messages between cache nodes
parseCacheRequest :: String -> IO (Maybe (String, String, String))
parseCacheRequest xmlContent = do
  let parserConfig = [ withValidate no
                     , withSubstDTDEntities yes
                     , withParseByMimeType no
                     ]
  results <- runX $ readString parserConfig xmlContent >>>
    proc doc -> do
      op  <- doc //> hasName "operation" /> getText -< ()
      key <- doc //> hasName "key" /> getText -< ()
      val <- doc //> hasName "value" /> getText -< ()
      returnA -< (op, key, val)
  return $ listToMaybe results

-- Process a cache command received from a peer node
-- The XML protocol allows nodes to exchange cache entries
processPeerMessage :: String -> String -> IO (Either String String)
processPeerMessage token xmlMessage = do
  sess <- validateSession token ReadWrite
  case sess of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Access denied: insufficient privileges"
    Just s  -> do
      parsed <- parseCacheRequest xmlMessage
      case parsed of
        Nothing -> return $ Left "Malformed cache protocol message"
        Just (op, key, val) -> executeCacheOp s op key val

-- Execute validated cache operation
executeCacheOp :: Session -> String -> String -> String -> IO (Either String String)
executeCacheOp session op key val = case op of
  "GET" -> do
    store <- readIORef cacheStore
    case Map.lookup key store of
      Nothing -> return $ Left "Key not found"
      Just entry ->
        if roleLevel (sessionRole session) >= roleLevel (entryACL entry)
        then return $ Right (entryValue entry)
        else return $ Left "Access denied for this entry"
  "SET" -> do
    let entry = CacheEntry val (sessionUser session) (sessionRole session)
    modifyIORef' cacheStore (Map.insert key entry)
    return $ Right "OK"
  "DEL" -> do
    sess <- validateSession (sessionToken session) Admin
    case sess of
      Nothing -> return $ Left "Delete requires Admin role"
      Just _  -> do
        modifyIORef' cacheStore (Map.delete key)
        return $ Right "OK"
  _ -> return $ Left "Unknown operation"

-- Bulk import cache entries from XML manifest
-- Used during cluster rebalancing
bulkImport :: String -> String -> IO (Either String Int)
bulkImport token xmlManifest = do
  sess <- validateSession token Admin
  case sess of
    Nothing -> return $ Left "Bulk import requires Admin role"
    Just s  -> do
      entries <- parseCacheConfig xmlManifest
      mapM_ (\(k, v) -> executeCacheOp s "SET" k v) entries
      return $ Right (length entries)

-- Health check endpoint that returns node status as XML
nodeStatus :: IO String
nodeStatus = do
  store <- readIORef cacheStore
  let count = Map.size store
  return $ "<status><entries>" ++ show count ++ "</entries><healthy>true</healthy></status>"
